statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-118664 (denial of service through quadratic replacement of percent-encoded runs) is in the decode-uri-component package before 0.5.1: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qr28-fpjm-wq7f. Jaeger embeds the prebuilt UI of the jaeger-ui release with the same version number in /usr/bin/jaeger, the only file in the package, as gzip-compressed assets. Decompressed those assets in every published build of the jaeger-dev package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, on both x86_64 and aarch64: 21 builds, 2.19.0-r1 through 2.23.0-r4. Every build of one Jaeger version embeds the same UI bundle: for 2.19.0 to 2.22.0 the decompressed file that holds the decoder is byte-identical (same SHA-256) to the matching file in the assets.tar.gz of that jaeger-ui release (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/releases), and from 2.23.0-r0 neither the embedded assets nor the v2.23.0 release assets contain the decoder's '%[a-f0-9]{2}' pattern or its '%FE%FF' replacement table. decode-uri-component carries no version string, so its version comes from each jaeger-ui release's lockfile, checked against the decompressed bundle: jaeger-ui v2.19.0 and v2.20.0 lock decode-uri-component 0.4.1 (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.19.0/package-lock.json, https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.20.0/pnpm-lock.yaml) and the bundles in 2.19.0-r1 to 2.20.0-r5 contain the 0.4.1 decoder; v2.21.0 and v2.22.0 lock 0.5.0 (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.21.0/pnpm-lock.yaml) and the bundles in 2.21.0-r0 to 2.22.0-r3 contain the 0.5.0 decoder, which still rewrites the input once per distinct percent-encoded run; v2.23.0 no longer depends on decode-uri-component (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-ui/blob/v2.23.0/pnpm-lock.yaml) and the bundles from 2.23.0-r0 contain none of its code. So 2.23.0-r0 is the first build without an affected decode-uri-component, and 2.19.0-r1 to 2.22.0-r3 carry 0.4.1 or 0.5.0.
